svg.text: 0.3 N m about the tip bisector, 3 mm behind the point; read from 4.5 to 15 mm
Reproduces the record's SF bit for bit (Tier 2 at h 0.2, same platform).
Colour scale tops at the read-out peak (4.5-15.0 mm from the point); stresses at the loaded patch run above it.
